description.text: This resolution provides for the consideration of the bill (H.R. 6039) to advance commonsense priorities.

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Rules.

bill.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 6039) to advance commonsense priorities.

aiDescription.summary: H. Res. 884 orders immediate consideration of H.R. 6039, waives all points of order, deems a Rules Committee minority-filed substitute adopted, and limits debate to one hour. It allows one motion to recommit, suspends clause 1(c) of rule XIX and clause 8 of rule XX, and directs prompt Senate notification.

impact.summary: This resolution orders immediate floor consideration of H.R. 6039, waives points of order, limits debate to one hour, and treats a Rules minority substitute as adopted. It affects House members, the Committee on Rules, majority and minority leaders (or designees), the Clerk, and the Senate.
